# A real SMTP conversation with Mailpit v1.34.0 (docker.io/axllent/mailpit:latest on 2026-11-19,
# started without any option), the kind of relay the homelab has: no TLS, no login.
# Recorded with a raw socket; "C:" is what the client sent, "S:" what Mailpit answered.
# Only the container's host name was changed, to "relay". The fake relay in smtp_test.go
# answers with these lines.
S: 220 relay Mailpit ESMTP Service ready
C: EHLO workstation.example
S: 250-relay greets workstation.example
S: 250-SIZE 52428800
S: 250-ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES
S: 250-8BITMIME
S: 250 SMTPUTF8
C: MAIL FROM:<upkeep@example.net>
S: 250 2.1.0 Ok
C: RCPT TO:<owner@example.net>
S: 250 2.1.5 Ok
C: RCPT TO:not-an-address
S: 501 5.5.4 Syntax error in parameters or arguments (invalid TO parameter)
C: DATA
S: 354 Start mail input; end with <CR><LF>.<CR><LF>
C: <message> .
S: 250 2.0.0 Ok: queued as 3o8j55ULHTsniP2Z2QJfYr
C: AUTH PLAIN AHVzZXIAcGFzcw==
S: 502 5.5.1 Command not implemented
C: STARTTLS
S: 502 5.5.1 Command not implemented
C: NOSUCH
S: 500 5.5.2 Syntax error, command unrecognized
C: QUIT
S: 221 2.0.0 relay Mailpit ESMTP Service closing transmission channel
